## Site Name
NGO / Non-profit (GiveHope) — A NexusAI Demo

## Purpose
A mission-driven website for NGOs and non-profits with campaign showcases, donation flows, and impact reports.

## Industry
Non-profit / Social Impact

## Key Features
- Transparent Impact: Every rupee tracked — detailed impact reports published quarterly.
- Active Campaigns: Join ongoing campaigns in education, environment, and health.
- Easy Donations: UPI, net banking, credit/debit cards — donate in under 60 seconds.
- Volunteer: Join thousands of volunteers making a difference on the ground.
- 80G Tax Benefit: All donations eligible for 80G tax deduction under Income Tax Act.
- Annual Reports: Full financial transparency with independently audited accounts.
